positions.title: Wire Harness Assembler
positions.summary: Hands-on production role building wire harnesses and cable assemblies at our Kansas City facility. Manufacturing experience is a plus but not required, we'll train the right person.
positions.description:
Quality Cable Systems builds wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and box builds for OEM customers who depend on quality and reliability. Our work goes directly into equipment in the field, so getting it right matters. We're under new leadership and investing heavily in our people, technology, and processes. We're looking for Wire Harness Assemblers to join our growing team, whether you have previous manufacturing experience or are building a long-term career in production.

What you'll do: build wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and related products by hand using work instructions, drawings, hand tools, and production equipment. You'll learn to read and follow build documentation, identify quality issues, and complete assemblies accurately and efficiently, working closely with Team Leads and experienced assemblers. You'll also help keep the work area clean, organized, and safe, and support packaging, labeling, and other production tasks as needed.

Details: this role is on-site at our Kansas City, MO facility, with a flexible start date. You'll report to Production Leadership; it's an individual contributor role with no direct reports. We offer competitive hourly pay based on experience.

What we're looking for:
Dependable, with strong attendance and work ethic
Comfortable working with your hands and performing repetitive tasks
Detail-oriented and committed to producing quality work
Able to follow written and verbal instructions
Willing to learn new skills and processes
Comfortable in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
A strong team player
Manufacturing or assembly experience is a plus, but not required

Physical requirements:
Standing for extended periods during shifts
Frequent use of hands for repetitive assembly tasks
Lifting and moving materials up to 25 pounds occasionally
Identifying colors, small components, and detailed assembly work

To apply, reach out to our hiring team at careers@qualitycablesystems.com.
